option_relations.rationale: Atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome (aHUS) is a distinct thrombotic microangiopathy from Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP).

Pancreatitis-Associated Thrombotic Microangiopathy is a descriptive term for a syndrome, but it is not directly equivalent to Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP) nor is TTP a subtype or supertype of it. It could potentially be a manifestation or complication, but the relation is not strong enough to be definitive without more context.
Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (HUS) is a distinct thrombotic microangiopathy from Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP).
Atypical Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (aHUS) is a distinct thrombotic microangiopathy from Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP).
